## MidnightTakeLendAction interface

Metadata for a Midnight bundle that lends into fixed-rate offers.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface MidnightTakeLendAction extends BaseAction<"midnightTakeLend", {
    readonly market: Hex;

    readonly taker: Address;

    readonly deadline: bigint;
}>
```
